Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

The role:

As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

Your responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

Your qualifications:

We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

We expect that you will have:

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

It is a distinct advantage if you:

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

Your personal profile:

You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

Why join NNIT:

At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

We offer:

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

About NNIT:

NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

Apply now

If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

A senior legal role with genuine influence

Fertin Pharma is looking for a Senior Group Legal Counsel who combines strong legal judgement with commercial perspective and the confidence to advise at executive level. You will be entrusted with complex, high-impact matters where the legal path is not always defined—and where your ability to set direction, balance risk and opportunity, and turn complexity into decisive advice will directly influence business outcomes.

Reporting to the VP, Head of Legal, Regulatory and QA, you will operate as a senior individual contributor and legal owner across key business areas. Although the role has no direct line management responsibility, it carries a clear functional leadership mandate: you will shape legal strategy, challenge and support senior stakeholders, lead cross-functional initiatives and set standards for how Legal enables the organisation.

Your mandate

• Strategic legal leadership: Develop and implement legal strategies and risk mitigation frameworks for key business areas, aligned with Fertin’s business objectives, group requirements and legal risk appetite.

• Executive and senior stakeholder counsel: Provide expert, commercially pragmatic legal advice to senior management and cross-functional leaders on complex legal, commercial, regulatory, governance and reputational matters.

• Commercial contracts and business support: Own the legal strategy, negotiation approach and risk position for material commercial agreements, including customer, supplier, development, manufacturing, licensing and strategic collaboration arrangements.

• IP and confidential know-how: Lead the legal framework for protecting Fertin’s IP, know-how and confidential information in commercial and R&D collaborations, including ownership, access rights, confidentiality and contractual protections

• Compliance/GDPR: Lead and implement legal compliance and data protection frameworks in relevant areas, including GDPR, confidentiality, sanctions, third-party risk and group policies, in coordination with PMI Legal where relevant.

• Regulatory, quality and product-related legal matters: Act as legal owner for strategic input into regulatory, quality and product-related matters, identifying legal risks and developing practical solutions across functions and jurisdictions.

• Corporate governance: Develop and implement governance processes, powers of attorney, corporate approvals, board/management documentation and internal legal policies to support clear decision-making and accountability.

• Disputes and claims: Lead the legal handling of disputes, claims and settlement strategies, including legal assessment, risk exposure, negotiation strategy and coordination with external counsel.

• Group and intercompany matters: Support legal structuring and documentation for intercompany arrangements, intra-group services and group governance matters, ensuring clear responsibilities and alignment with business, tax and Finance stakeholders.

• Legal processes, templates and standards: Develop and improve legal processes, contract standards, templates, playbooks and ways of working to strengthen quality, efficiency, consistency and risk management across the organisation.

• AI adoption in Legal: Lead responsible use of AI tools within Legal, including identifying use cases, setting governance principles and ensuring confidentiality, quality and legal risk controls.

The senior profile we are looking for

• You hold a Master of Laws, cand.jur., cand.merc.jur. or an equivalent legal qualification.

• You bring at least five years of relevant experience from an international in-house legal function and/or a law firm, with a track record that demonstrates senior-level judgement and ownership.

• You have substantial experience with sophisticated commercial agreements and legal risk management; experience within compliance, governance, IP or regulated industries will be a strong advantage.

• You are comfortable operating where matters are complex, cross-border or ambiguous, and you know when to decide, challenge, involve others or escalate.

• You can move confidently between strategic advice and hands-on execution—from executive counsel and negotiation strategy to drafting, implementation and follow-through.

• You communicate with authority and clarity, build credibility quickly and can influence stakeholders without relying on formal management authority.

• You are commercially pragmatic without compromising legal integrity, and you are motivated by building solutions and standards that last.

Your impact

This role offers the opportunity to influence decisions close to the business, own matters of strategic importance and leave a visible mark on how Legal operates across Fertin Pharma. Your success will be reflected not only in sound legal outcomes, but also in stronger decision-making, clearer risk ownership and legal frameworks that enable the organisation to move forward with confidence.

Interested?

If you are an experienced legal professional who wants more than a traditional advisory role—and are ready to take ownership, influence senior stakeholders and shape the legal agenda in an international and highly regulated environment—we would like to hear from you.

Special Conditions

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates who accept an offer of employment with Fertin. A satisfactory background check is a condition of employment.

The background check is a standard and important part of our hiring process and is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as Fertin’s internal compliance and integrity requirements.

Do you have a passion for robotics and automation? And would you like to see the solutions you work with come to life at customer sites around the world?

At Inwatec, we develop and build advanced automation and robotic solutions for industrial laundries worldwide. We are looking for a Software Commissioning Engineer who enjoys combining software, robotics, and hands-on problem solving.

You will work closely with our engineers in Denmark, but a big part of your job happens where our solutions are put into action: at customer sites around the world.

YOUR TASKS

• Programming and configuring robots, machines PC and PLC systems

• Testing and commissioning systems at customer sites

• Implementing our automation solutions worldwide

• Troubleshooting software, PLC, network and machine-related issues

• Fine-tuning systems to ensure stability and performance

• Supporting customers during installation and start-up by being the ”Face on-site”

• Being co-responsible in cutomer teaching of our system during training and meetings

• Working closely with our software team to improve existing solutions and develop new features through feedback from site

YOUR PROFILE

• You have a degree in robotics, automation, software, engineering or a similar technical field

• You have an interest in programming, robotics, and industrial automation

• You enjoy hands-on problem solving, and seeing your solutions work in the real world

• You are curious, independent, and comfortable taking responsibility on-site

• You are fluent in English and confident communicating with customers and colleagues internationally. Additional language skills, particularly German or French, are an advantage

• Previous experience with PLCs, robotics, commissioning or industrial machinery is an advantage, but not necessarily a requirement

• You have a category B driver's license

• You are excited about travelling. The position includes approximately 100–150 travel days per year, primarily for commissioning at customer sites worldwide

WE OFFER

• A job where you combine software, robotics, and real-world engineering

• The opportunity to follow solutions from testing in Denmark to full operation at customer sites

• International experience through projects around the world, involving travel from a few days to a couple of weeks, and occasionally longer trips with the possibility of a break along the way

• A high degree of responsibility and freedom in your work

• Skilled colleagues within software, automation, and engineering

• Good opportunities to develop both your technical and personal skills

• An informal working environment with short decision-making processes

One week you might be testing a system in Denmark. The next, you could be commissioning a robot on the other side of the world.

If that sounds like the kind of engineering job you are looking for, we would like to hear from you.

INWATEC - THE LAUNDRYNERDS

JENSEN-Group is a global leader in industrial laundry technology, with roots on Bornholm and a strong developmental focus. Inwatec ApS is part of JENSEN-GROUP, and Inwatec develops and produces machines and robots for industrial laundries worldwide. We are a fast-moving company in rapid development and our team is creative and dynamic, with very dedicated employees. We love our informal work environment, where every idea is taken seriously and everybody is treated equally. On Fridays, we meet at our bar for an after-work beer or some ping-pong.

We are looking forward to moving into beautiful new offices on Hvidkærvej, Odense in 2027.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Experience Design transforms complex financial workflows into intuitive solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. We bridge sophisticated investment technology with the people who depend on it — portfolio managers, compliance officers, and analysts operating in high-stakes environments where precision and speed matter.

Our Global Experience Design team operates as a centralized center of excellence with distributed impact. We maintain unified standards and processes globally while embedding designers directly within product teams for deep collaboration and contextual expertise. This lets us stay consistent across SimCorp's product ecosystem while scaling expertise efficiently across markets and time zones.

As Principal Experience Designer, you will serve as the senior design authority for our most complex, strategic initiatives, influence design direction across multiple teams, and mentor senior designers.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead design for SimCorp's most complex and strategic initiatives, contributing to the overall strategic vision and design craft excellence.

• Establish design patterns and standards adopted across the organization, and influence design system evolution and adoption.

• Drive innovation in financial technology user experience, influencing multiple products across the organization.

• Partner with senior product leadership on roadmap planning, and represent the design perspective in architectural and technical decisions.

• Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert in UX.

• Work closely with engineering leadership on technical feasibility, and collaborate with user research on strategic research initiatives.

• Partner with customer success to integrate user feedback, and present design vision to executive stakeholders.

• Work independently and cross-functionally with senior leadership.

• Mentor Lead and Senior Experience Designers, and contribute to hiring decisions for senior design roles.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to — and interested in — learn the rest.

• 8+ years of design experience, with deep expertise in enterprise software.

• Proven track record leading complex, multi-team design initiatives.

• Strong systems thinking and design pattern recognition.

• Ability to navigate between high-level strategy and detailed execution.

• Skill in translating complex financial concepts into clear, actionable interfaces.

• Experience getting the most from AI tools in crafting creative solutions.

• Experience mentoring senior designers and design leaders.

• Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and drive stakeholder consensus.

• Self-directed and results-oriented, taking ownership of projects while contributing to our collective design practice.

• Experience with the fintech domain is a plus.

**Benefits

**Attractive salary and bonus scheme are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model - working from SimCorp's office two days a week. And opportunities for professional development: there is never only one route - we offer a personal approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

SimCorp welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Candidates who require accommodation during the recruitment process should contact the People & Culture team at PeopleandCultureAmericas@simcorp.com.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Please note: Only applications sent through our system will be processed.

For New York City only: The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $241,000 USD. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including health care, leave, and retirement plans. Your total compensation may vary based on role, location, department and individual performance.

Are you a passionate engineer with experience in product development and quality? Do you want to be part of a cross-functional and global work environment? Do you want to join us to continue to deliver on our ambition creating a world class organization where we thrive are proud and motivated to deliver solutions that improve patient lives?

Then this might be your defining moment. Apply today and join us as our R&D Innovation **New Product Introduction Engineer (Process Development), based in Ballerup, Denmark.

****About The Role

**As part of the Global New Process Introduction organization, you will collaborate closely with R&D designers to influence the product design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM and DFA). You will be responsible for designing, setting up, and validating the process. While working from our Headquarters in Ballerup, Copenhagen area, you will join a global team of colleagues across Denmark, Germany, USA, and Asia, and you will report directly to our NPI Manager, based in Ballerup.

**Key Responsibilities

**In this role, you will be working with a team of project members from cross functions to develop and deliver a new medical product to the market. The role entails varied tasks; however, your main responsibilities will include:

• Lead and/or participate in the development of manufacturing processes and process equipment of new and existing product lines according to current business strategy, quality management system and external regulations

• Process development, validation, optimization, definition of specification and implementation of manufacturing processes

• Utilize Design for Manufacturing and Design for Assembly approaches into process development work

• Responsible for development, specification, technical sourcing/ purchasing and implementation of internal and external manufacturing processes

• Optimize product or process design in cooperation with other functions within R&D

• Process expert for internal and/or external manufacturing processes

• Optimize process or product implementation using appropriate tools

• Be part of an international and local integrated development team and participate in project task where and when required

Traveling might occur in the range of 0-20 days per year.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. To make this path achievable, you likely have experience within healthcare or the medical device industry, particularly in quality processes and design control, either in Engineering or R&D. Experience with risk management for medical devices is also a valuable part of your skill set. Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Carry a degree in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant discipline engineering disipline.

• Have a structured approach to your work, whilst remaining open-minded and keep an eye out for driving towards success

• Are a cohesion-minded team player

• Are a self-driven project-oriented individual, with a good analytical toolbox and a ‘’can-do’’-attitude

• Thrive in an international environment that is characterized by cross-functional teamwork

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social, and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Are you ready to take ownership of financial planning and performance management in a global MedTech company?

**Do you thrive at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business partnering? Are you able to translate complex financial data into clear insights and recommendations for senior management? And do you enjoy contributing to projects and initiatives that drive business performance and improve financial processes?

Then you could be Ambu's next Senior FP&A Business Partner.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Senior FP&A Business Partner, you will join the FP&A team within Business Finance & Analytics, covering FP&A, Commercial Finance, Strategic Finance, Operational Finance, and BI & Data Science. Reporting to the Senior FP&A Manager, you will play an important role in shaping Ambu’s financial planning and performance management processes while contributing to executive decision-making across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you will work closely with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and Executive Management. You will own key planning activities, drive performance insights, and support cross-functional initiatives that contribute to Ambu's continued growth and transformation. The role offers a unique opportunity to combine financial expertise and business partnering in an international environment with exposure to senior leadership and strategic priorities.

This position provides an excellent platform for further development within Business and Strategic Finance.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Owning key elements of the annual financial planning cycle, including budgeting, forecasting, and target setting.

• Driving parts of cross-functional planning and performance management processes in close collaboration with Finance, Commercial, Operations, and functional leadership teams.

• Analyzing business performance and providing actionable insights, recommendations, and decision support to senior management.

• Preparing and presenting financial analyses and performance updates for Executive Management while driving management and Board reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate, and consistent delivery.

• Identifying and implementing improvements to FP&A processes, reporting, and performance management, leveraging digital solutions and AI tools such as Copilot.

• Supporting strategic and transformational initiatives, including finance transformation, process optimization, performance improvement programs, data-driven decision support, and selected activities related to Ambu's multi-year ERP transformation.

**Suggested candidate profile

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you combine strong financial expertise with a genuine interest in understanding the business behind the numbers.

You Likely Bring Experience From FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, Management Consulting, Or a Similar Environment Where You Have Supported Decision-making Through Financial Planning, Performance Management, And Business Partnering. Additionally, You

• Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Have 6-8 years of experience driving budgeting, forecasting, and performance management processes in complex organizations.

• Have experience working in a global organization where commercial, operational, and financial performance are closely interconnected and require cross-functional planning and performance management.

• Are comfortable working closely with senior stakeholders and preparing analyses and presentations for Executive Leadership Teams and/or Boards of Directors.

• Have experience driving projects or workstreams involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

• Build trust and credibility through strong communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to navigate effectively across functions and organizational levels.

• Are analytical, structured, and proactive, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Experience with Power BI, Copilot, or other AI-enabled finance tools is considered an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Location: Copenhagen or Århus.

Are you interested about customers and future proof design? Then look here!

We are hiring an IP MPLS Specialist for our IP Transport network team. You will play a key role in defining network strategies, driving technical designs, and ensuring seamless execution. Work alongside a team of top experts and help create scalable, secure, and future-proof solutions that position Norlys at the forefront of the Telco industry in Denmark.

Plan, design, and build today for tomorrow’s network

Norlys Transport team is part of Telco Architecture & Planning. Our ambition is to plan, design, and build a network today that caters for tomorrow’s needs.

The Transport team consists of eight highly skilled IP/MPLS, sync, and optical transport network engineers with a strong team spirit. We are responsible for defining and ensuring a cost-efficient, resilient, and future-proof network architecture with clear roadmaps, network rules, and lifecycle management. We handle vendors and evaluate and select systems and partners for all transport platforms.

Your main responsibilities will be to

• Handle end-to-end network connectivity deliveries between internal and external platforms such as mobile core and probing systems.

• Define IP/MPLS network rules and design.

• Manage firewalls and probing equipment.

• Lead lifecycle management.

• Ensure automation of service development.

Your profile includes

• Experience from working with IP MPLS design and lifecycle management.

• Solid understanding of routing protocols and redundant setups.

• Knowledge of test management and CPE/service validation.

• Preferably CCNP certification.

Requirements

• Ability to obtain a Danish Security Clearance.

• Ability to work from our Norlys office in Århus or Copenhagen several days per week.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken. Danish is an advantage.

Join us!

If you have questions, you can contact Senior Manager of Architecture, Development & Design, Henriette Pedersen at 28 27 08 48 or hpeder@norlys.dk. Please send us your application and CV through our online recruitment system as soon as possible. You decide whether your application and CV should be in English or Danish, we do not differentiate.

Norlys is Denmark’s largest integrated energy and telecommunications group with approx. 800,000 co-op shareholders, 3.5 million customer relations, 4,600 employees and over 100 years of history. As a co-operative, taking responsibility for more than just ourselves is embedded in our DNA. That’s why we don’t just deliver future-proof solutions to Danish homes and companies. We also work consciously towards a green and digital transformation for all of society. And that is why we are passionate about creating progress for people, the local environment and the climate.

We hope you enjoy the experience. Because we believe that the future is as good as we make it. Together.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

• Testing: Playwright

• AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

• Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Are you the kind of person who notices when something could be better, and has the drive to make it happen? At DISA, quality is not just a checkpoint at the end of the process. It is built into the way we design, source, produce and deliver world-class foundry machines. We are looking for a Quality Engineer who wants to be close to the product, close to production and close to the decisions that improve how we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving real quality challenges in a manufacturing environment. Someone who is structured, curious and persistent enough to follow an issue from first observation to sustainable improvement.

What You’ll Do

• Take ownership of quality improvements across supplier quality, production quality and internal quality processes.

• Handle non-conformities, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and ensure follow-up until issues are properly closed.

• Work closely with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers to identify risks, solve quality challenges and prevent repeat issues.

• Support and develop supplier quality performance through audits, structured follow-up, documentation and improvement plans.

• Use data, facts and structured problem-solving tools to analyze trends, set priorities and recommend practical quality improvements.

• Contribute to audits, customer requirements and management systems, with ISO 14001 as an area where you have basic knowledge or interest.

• A role where quality is at the center — not a side responsibility.

• The chance to work hands-on with complex, high-precision equipment and see the impact of your improvements in real production.

• A workplace where your structure, curiosity and follow-through help prevent issues before they reach the customer.

• Close collaboration with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers, so you can turn observations into practical improvements.

• The opportunity to help strengthen quality culture in a global industrial company with strong products, proud craftsmanship and long product lifetimes.

You will not be sitting far away from the product or the people making it. You will be part of the daily dialogue around quality, helping colleagues and suppliers understand what went wrong, why it happened and how we make sure it does not happen again.

Who You Are

• You have a background in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Production Technology or a similar field.

• You have experience with quality work in a manufacturing, production or industrial environment.

• You are motivated by root cause analysis, corrective actions and the satisfaction of closing issues properly.

• You understand supplier quality or are eager to work closely with suppliers on deviations, audits, documentation and improvement plans.

• You like being close to the shop floor and working with people across functions to solve practical quality challenges.

• You are analytical and structured, but also pragmatic enough to find solutions that work in real life.

• You follow through — because you know that quality improvements only matter when they are actually implemented and sustained.

• You have knowledge of ISO 14001 or an interest in building a basic understanding of environmental management systems.

About Norican

NORICAN. Metal. Made. Possible.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA:

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.
